slides.title: A letter that sparkles
slides.text: A letter lands in the Netville post with big, exciting words. Pim reads it slowly. Exciting does not always mean true, says Pim.
slides.alt: A prize card from Prize Team, marked unknown sender: “You won a tablet!”

focus.cue: Big, exciting words: You won a tablet!
Read it slowly: who really sent it?

slides.title: Clues one and two
slides.text: Clue one is a rush: reply in ten minutes or lose it! Clue two is a prize for a contest you never entered.
slides.alt: The prize card's cues: hurry, only ten minutes; asks for the mailbox key; a prize you never entered; says congratulations. Then the three choices.

focus.cue: Clue one, the rush: only ten minutes
Clue two, a prize you never entered for

slides.title: Clues three and four
slides.text: Clue three: it comes from someone you do not know. Clue four asks for your key. Real companies and real games never ask for your passphrase.
slides.alt: A card from “Your bank”, marked unknown sender: “Your account is locked.”

focus.cue: Clue four: it asks for your mailbox key

slides.title: Count the clues
slides.text: Pim reads the tablet letter one more time. Count the clues hiding inside its friendly words before Pim decides.
steps: A prize you never entered for
A sender you do not know
slides.alt: Cues to tap: hurry, only ten minutes; asks for the mailbox key; a prize you never entered; says congratulations. Then Safe, Trick or Ask a trusted adult.

focus.cue: Tap every cue that smells like a trick

slides.title: What to do
slides.text: When you spot a trick, do not reply and do not tap anything. Show it to a trusted adult. A trick that fishes for secrets is called phishing.
slides.alt: Cues to tap: a button that wants a tap right now; talks about coins. Then three choices: Safe, Trick, Ask a trusted adult.

focus.cue: A button that wants a tap right now: do not tap

words.means: a message that tries to fool you
a trick message that fishes for your secrets
a hint that something is not what it seems
something you win in a game or a draw

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Trick Inbox at Prize Letters and sort all 6 letters. Tap every clue you can find, then choose a move: deliver, bin it, show Pim, or report and block.
slides.alt: A letter, “You won a tablet!”, with clues marked: you are our lucky winner; your mailbox key; in the next ten minutes.

focus.cue: Play Prize Letters: tap every clue, then choose
